Welcome to Data Visualization (STAT 2430) at Dalhousie University for Winter 2026. From this page you can access all the required elements of the course including

* the [syllabus](001-syllabus.qmd) for the whole course,
* the course [textbook](https://andrewirwin.github.io/data-viz-notes/),
* the [detailed schedule](002-detailed-outline.qmd) with a plan for each class (subject to change!) and a link to slides and other materials presented in class, 
* suggested [exercises](003-exercises.qmd) for each lesson, and
* detailed information about all work to be [evaluated](004-evaluation.qmd).

A few items are located on the Brightspace course page, including:

* links to forms for you to provide personal information to me (your GitHub ID, any preferences for a project partner)
* term project information: team membership, proposal presentation schedule, and 
* your grades in the course.

If you have questions about the course, please ask in class, during regular office hours, or contact me by [email](mailto:a.irwin@dal.ca).
